dcterms:description: The Google Billion Word dataset is one of the largest language modeling datasets with almost one billion tokens and a vocabulary of over 800K words. Words appearing less than 3 times are replaced with a special unknown symbol. The data is based on an English corpus of 30,301,028 sentences whose order has been shuffled.
dcterms:title: Google Billion Word Dataset

dcterms:description: WikiText-103 is a smaller dataset of over 100M tokens with a vocabulary of about 200K words. Unlike the Google Billion Word dataset, the sentences are consecutive, allowing models to condition on larger contexts rather than single sentences.
dcterms:title: WikiText-103
